title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
title_zh: OnTrack: 实时监测和干预LLM代理轨迹的流式结构感知最优运输方法

paragraphs.en: Agents are deployed in a wide range of applications ranging from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most of these applications, agents, by relying on the LLM, work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding or no supervision, which results in cost and safety issues due to irreversible actions taken by agents. Recent works have tried to resolve these issues by either using another safeguard agent to monitor its behavior or doing a post-hoc evaluation of the logs. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when the tokens are already burned and the damage done. To overcome this issue, we propose OnTrack , a streaming monitoring mechanism that, as the agent progresses in its task, compares its steps and the dependencies between them against recorded successful runs and alerts the user of potential issues or blocks the agent, taking about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (where we have access to historical runs of the task or similar variants, as well as tool schemas), the intermediate regime of accessing only tool schemas, and the final case of no prior knowledge—just the steps as they are being generated by the agent. Naturally, the expectation of the monitoring capability of OnTrack is reduced as data access is reduced, ranging from the detection of any violation of the plans to the detection of loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls without new results. Finally, we evaluate the performance of our proposed solution using SWE-bench trajectories. Evaluating based on the first 8 steps, the proposed method ranked the failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity-based approaches (+0.057 AUROC). Additionally, by deploying an abort policy on top of it, we save ∼ \sim 18% of the compute that would have been burned on agents heading to failure, and 83% of runs that were interrupted were actually heading to failure (5 out of every 6 aborts were correct).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体被部署在多种应用中，从行程规划器和股票交易到 IT 事件分类。 在这些应用中，大多数情况下，智能体依赖大语言模型（LLM）自主运行，几乎没有基于规则的安全保障或监督，这会导致因智能体采取不可逆操作而引发的成本和安全问题。 近期的研究尝试通过两种方式解决这些问题：使用另一个安全智能体来监控其行为，或对日志进行事后评估。 第一种方法会增加每一步的成本和延迟；第二种方法则在任务执行结束后才给出判断，此时令牌已被消耗，损害也已造成。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 OnTrack——一种流式监控机制：随着智能体在任务中逐步推进，它会将其步骤及步骤间的依赖关系与已记录的成功运行进行对比，并提醒用户潜在问题或阻止智能体继续执行，每步仅需约一毫秒。 我们在三种访问权限逐渐受限的场景下研究了这个问题：完全参考访问（可以访问该任务的历史运行记录或类似变体，以及工具方案）、仅能访问工具方案的中间场景，以及没有任何先验知识、只能看到智能体实时生成的步骤的最终场景。 显然，随着数据访问权限的降低，OnTrack 的监控能力预期也会下降，从能够检测任何计划违规行为，到仅能检测循环、停滞以及没有新结果的重复工具调用。 最后，我们使用 SWE-bench 轨迹来评估所提出解决方案的性能。 基于前 8 步进行评估时，该方法在识别失败轨迹方面的表现优于基于内容相似性的方法（AUROC 提升 +0.057）。 此外，通过在其基础上部署中止策略，我们节省了约 18% 原本会浪费在走向失败的智能体上的计算资源，并且在所有被中断的运行中，有 83% 实际上正走向失败（每 6 次中止中有 5 次是正确的）。

paragraphs.en: Agents are being deployed across different applications and industries. One of their advantages is the autonomy that they bring during execution. With minimal human interference, they can execute a given task. They can automatically plan a trip, make a reservation, and complete the payment. However, this autonomy, if unchecked, can cause a damaging impact from cost and safety aspects.

sents.en: However, this autonomy, if unchecked, can cause a damaging impact from cost and safety aspects.
sents.zh: 然而，如果这种自主性不受约束，可能会在成本和安全方面造成有害影响。

paragraphs.en: On the cost side, these agents are using significant resources for a single step in a task, but they could easily suffer from hallucinations, out-of-order tool calls, or infinite loops—all of which are costly due to the underlying LLM usage. From a safety perspective, these agents—unmonitored—can delete or modify a record by mistake or, as in recent incidents, break out of their sandbox environment and start hacking other systems as reported in the OpenAI–HuggingFace incident [ 1 ] . All these aspects require developing a monitoring system for agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在成本方面，这些智能体在执行任务的一个步骤中会消耗大量资源，但它们也很容易出现幻觉、工具调用顺序错误或无限循环等问题——由于底层大语言模型的使用，这些问题都会产生高昂的成本。 从安全角度来看，这些未经监控的智能体可能会误删或修改记录，或者像近期事件中的情况一样，突破其沙箱环境，开始入侵其他系统，正如 OpenAI–HuggingFace 事件 [1] 所报道的那样。 所有这些方面都要求为智能体开发一个监控系统。

paragraphs.en: The existing methods rely either on offline (after-the-fact) evaluations, where traces and logs are evaluated against a rule-based mechanism or language models are used as the judge (i.e., LLM-as-a-Judge [ 2 ] ). However, by the time an issue is found, the run has already been paid for. Online safeguards, on the other hand, monitor agents’ execution using another agent. First, this method is costly and also adds latency to the execution due to an extra call to an LLM. On top of that, to reduce the cost, these safeguards are usually equipped with smaller models which struggle to detect the mistakes of the larger models, or a dedicated model is trained to score every step which renders the mechanism a black box [ 3 ] . Moreover, none of these methods look at the structure or the topology of the runs, i.e., which steps depend on which, even though that is where loops or out-of-order calls show up.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法要么依赖离线（事后）评估，即根据基于规则的检查机制对执行轨迹和日志进行评估，要么使用语言模型作为评判者（即 LLM 作为评判者 [2]）。 然而，当问题被发现时，该次运行已经产生了费用。 另一方面，在线防护机制则通过另一个智能体来监控智能体的执行过程。 首先，这种方法成本高昂，并且由于需要额外调用一次 LLM，还会增加执行过程中的延迟。 此外，为了降低成本，这些防护机制通常采用较小的模型，而这些模型难以检测出较大模型的错误；或者需要训练一个专用模型对每一步进行评分，这使得整个机制变成了一个黑箱 [3]。 更甚者，这些方法均未关注运行的结构或拓扑关系，即哪些步骤依赖于哪些步骤，尽管循环或顺序错误的调用恰恰就出现在这种关系中。

paragraphs.en: To overcome this issue, we propose a streaming monitoring mechanism called OnTrack . This approach models the agent’s progress toward completing the task as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) in which each step of the graph corresponds to one node and, if a step’s output is used in another step, there is an edge between them. As the run unfolds, the monitor compares this growing graph against reference solutions using optimal transport and flags potential issues in about a millisecond per step. The references are optional, however—the monitor runs with whatever is available. With tool schemas alone, it still catches loops and stalls and blocks an irreversible action whose declared prerequisites are missing; with nothing but the event stream, loop and stall detection remain. Nothing is reconfigured across these regimes; parts of the monitor simply switch off as their inputs disappear.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为 OnTrack 的流式监控机制。 该方法将智能体完成任务的进展建模为一个有向无环图（DAG），其中图中的每个步骤对应一个节点；如果某一步骤的输出被另一个步骤使用，则两者之间存在一条边。 随着运行过程展开，监控器会利用最优传输方法将此不断增长的图与参考解决方案进行比较，并在每个步骤中约一毫秒内标记出潜在问题。 不过，参考方案是可选的——监控器只要有可用数据即可运行。 仅凭工具模式，它仍能检测出循环和停滞，并阻止那些声明前提条件缺失的不可逆操作；如果仅依赖事件流，则仍能够检测循环和停滞。 在这些不同模式之间，没有任何部分会被重新配置；监控器的某些部分在输入消失时会自动关闭。

paragraphs.en: Using a post hoc evaluation method in the middle of the trajectory will penalize the agent for every reference step it has not reached yet. So, the comparison punishes the agent for being early rather than being wrong—exactly the stage where the monitor most needs to stay quiet. Additionally, considering the portion of the reference that has been covered mid-stream is meaningless. For example, covering 10 of the 30 reference steps could be perfect progress if the agent is at step 10, and can be an indicator of a stuck agent if it is at step 80.
paragraphs.zh: 在轨迹中间阶段使用事后评估方法，会因智能体尚未达到的每一个参考步骤而对其进行惩罚。 因此，这种比较惩罚的是智能体过早完成而非错误完成——而这恰恰是监控器最需要保持沉默的阶段。 此外，在流程中途考虑已覆盖的参考部分并无意义。 例如，如果智能体处于第 10 步，那么覆盖了 30 个参考步骤中的 10 个可能意味着进展完美；但如果它处于第 80 步，这则可能表明智能体陷入了停滞。

paragraphs.en: Edges are discovered later when a step (node) uses an output of another step. As a result, a new step immediately after just being generated can seem disconnected and might look like the agent is hallucinating. paragraphs.en: OnTrack addresses all four challenges. For S1, the monitor only expects the parts of the reference the agent could have reached so far, so an agent is never punished for being early (Sec. 4.2 ). For S2, a new step’s structural influence starts at zero and phases in as later steps use its output; edges discovered late are inserted into the graph in place (Sec. 4.4 ). For S3, instead of re-solving the alignment at every step, we take one warm-started iteration of the batch solver per event — about a millisecond per step — and run the solver to convergence only before acting on an intervention (Sec. 4.3 ). For S4, decisions come from per-step signals with a short grace window for new steps, never from the aggregate score (Sec. 4.5 ). At the end of the run, one final solve makes the monitor’s output identical to the batch evaluator’s — provided the dependencies discovered online match what batch extraction would find (Prop. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: OnTrack 解决了所有四个挑战。 对于 S1，监控器仅期望智能体到目前为止可能已经达到的参考部分，因此智能体绝不会因提前完成而受到惩罚（第 4.2 节）。 对于 S2，新步骤的结构影响从零开始，并在后续步骤使用其输出时逐渐引入；较晚发现的边会直接插入到图中（第 4.4 节）。 对于 S3，我们不在每一步都重新解决对齐问题，而是为每个事件执行一次批量求解器的预启动迭代——每步约一毫秒——并且仅在根据干预措施采取行动之前将求解器运行至收敛（第 4.3 节）。 对于 S4，决策来自每一步的信号，为新步骤设有短暂的宽限窗口，而绝不会基于汇总得分做出（第 4.5 节）。 在运行结束时，一次最终的求解会使监控器的输出与批量评估器的输出完全一致——前提是在线发现的依赖关系与批量提取所发现的结果相匹配（命题 1）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating an agent trajectory still means choosing between a cheap score and a detailed one. Outcome-only benchmarks [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] collapse a run to pass or fail, so the steps that produced the outcome never enter the score. Text metrics that match a trace against a reference (exact match, BLEU/ROUGE, embedding alignment [ 8 ] ) do look inside the run, but they assume the task has one correct wording. A broken plan that resembles the reference can then rank above a valid plan written differently, and [ 4 ] shows that this ranking can fall below chance. LLM-as-a-judge [ 2 ] and process reward models [ 3 ] score individual steps, so they are not stuck on a single reference. The cost is practical: a judge adds latency, cost, and run-to-run noise, and a reward model needs step-level annotation before it can be trained. These methods also wait until the run has finished. Observability platforms that sit on live traffic store detailed traces, but the checks they apply while a run is open are schema validation, token heuristics, and judges applied asynchronously to spans that have already closed. We are not aware of a deployed system that reasons about the structure of the execution graph while that graph is still growing.
paragraphs.zh: 评估智能体轨迹仍然意味着在廉价得分和详细得分之间做出选择。 仅基于结果的基准 [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] 将一次运行简化为通过或失败，因此产生该结果的步骤从未被纳入评分。 将轨迹与参考文本进行匹配的文字指标（精确匹配、BLEU/ROUGE、嵌入对齐 [ 8 ] ）确实会检查运行过程，但它们假设任务只有一个正确的表述方式。 一个与参考文本相似的错误计划可能会排在以不同方式书写的有效计划之前，而 [ 4 ] 表明这种排序甚至可能低于随机水平。 “LLM作为裁判” [ 2 ] 和流程奖励模型 [ 3 ] 会对单个步骤进行评分，因此它们不会局限于单一的参考文本。 其成本是实际存在的：裁判会增加延迟、成本和运行间的噪声，而奖励模型在训练前需要完成步骤级的标注工作。 这些方法也需要等到运行完全结束后才能执行。 部署在实时流量上的可观察性平台会存储详细轨迹，但在运行仍在进行时所执行的检查仅限于模式验证、词元启发式方法，以及对已结束的跨度异步应用的裁判。 我们目前尚未发现任何已部署的系统能够在执行图仍在扩展时对其结构进行推理。

paragraphs.en: The solver is built from standard parts. Entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations [ 9 ] made optimal transport usable in practice. Unbalanced variants [ 10 ] relax exact conservation of mass, so mass that should not be matched can be discarded. Gromov–Wasserstein [ 11 ] compares relational structure, and its fused form [ 12 ] does the same for attributed graphs. Warm-started incremental Sinkhorn schemes already exist for problems that change slowly [ 13 ] . OnTrack uses that warm start. What changes between solves is more specific: the support grows by one row with each event, and the reference marginal moves as the agent progresses. That combination, as far as we know, is new.
paragraphs.zh: 该求解器由标准组件构建而成。 熵正则化和辛克霍恩迭代 [ 9 ] 使最优传输在实际应用中变得可行。 非平衡变体 [ 10 ] 放宽了质量的严格守恒要求，因此无需匹配的质量可以被舍弃。 格罗莫夫–瓦瑟斯坦距离 [ 11 ] 用于比较关系结构，其融合形式 [ 12 ] 则对带属性图执行同样的操作。 对于变化缓慢的问题，已有采用暖启动的增量式辛克霍恩方案 [ 13 ] 。 OnTrack 利用了这种暖启动机制。 不同求解步骤之间的变化更为具体：每次事件发生后，支撑集都会增加一行，而参考边际分布也会随着智能体的进展而移动。 据我们所知，这种组合是全新的。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior work is Otap [ 4 ] , which scores a completed trajectory after the fact by aligning attributed execution DAGs. We adopt its graph formalism and its node costs. Three findings from its ablations constrained the streaming design. The structure term is load-bearing. Restricting the method to a single reference costs 16.9 AUROC points. And the largest source of error is heuristic dependency extraction. From there, this paper asks a different question. Frontier masking, the streaming solver, provisional-structure handling, the verdict engine, and the calibration finding have no counterpart in the batch setting, because a batch scorer only has to say how good a finished run was. OnTrack has to decide whether the run should be allowed to continue.

paragraphs.en: To formulate the agent behavior, consider how an agent tackles a problem. It generates a stream of steps in which, at each step it describes what it is doing, calls a tool with the required arguments, and receives its result. Steps here are not independent from one another; the artifact (a queried database, a tool result) produced at this step can be consumed as input to other steps down the road. As a result, this execution is not a flat sequence; it is a growing dependency graph. Importantly, these links are not always visible at the moment a step is taken. paragraphs.en: Orthogonal to the harness’s log quality — which determines how well the prefix graph can be built — is how much prior knowledge the monitor is given to compare that graph against . We consider three nested settings, ordered by how much the monitor is given, and its capabilities degrade explicitly across them. With references and tool schemas , everything below is available: structural alignment against the references, per-step leakage, and the pre-execution gate for irreversible actions. With schemas but no references , the monitor can still catch self-evident pathologies — loops, stalls, repeated calls that produce nothing new — and still block an irreversible action whose declared prerequisites are missing; what it loses is any notion of deviation from a plan, since there is no plan to deviate from. With neither , only the self-referential vital signs remain — the honest minimum, and still enough to flag the runaway-loop failure mode that dominates real cost overruns (Sec. 6.4 ). A fourth axis is reference quality : a hand-curated gold run, a mined past success, and a machine-generated sketch do not deserve equal trust, so the authority of a verdict is scaled by reference provenance (Sec. 4.6 ). Figure 2 summarizes both axes.
paragraphs.zh: 与 harness 的日志质量（这决定了前缀图能够构建得有多好）正交的是，监控系统被赋予了多少先验知识来对该图进行比较。 我们考虑了三种嵌套设置，按监控系统所获信息的多少排序，其能力在这些设置中会明确下降。 在有参考和工具模式的情况下，以下所有功能均可使用：与参考的结构对齐、每一步的泄露检测，以及对不可逆操作的执行前闸门。 在有模式但无参考的情况下，监控系统仍然能够发现自明的问题——如循环、停滞、未产生任何新结果的重复调用——并且仍能阻止因缺少声明前提条件而触发的不可逆操作；但它失去的是对偏离计划的任何判断，因为此时根本不存在可供偏离的计划。 在两者皆无的情况下，只剩下自我参照的生命体征——这是最基础的诚实信息，但依然足以标记出导致实际成本超支的主要失控循环故障模式（第 6.4 节）。 第四个维度是参考的质量：人工精选的黄金运行记录、从过往成功中挖掘的案例，以及机器生成的草图，都不应获得同等程度的信任，因此判断的权威性会根据参考的来源进行加权（第 4.6 节）。 图 2 总结了这两个维度。

paragraphs.en: This section builds the monitor in two parts. We first recall the batch alignment that OnTrack inherits — the cost table and the objective — and the monitor’s three-layer architecture; we then develop the streaming components that answer the four challenges of the introduction: the mass semantics (Sec. 4.1 ), the frontier mask for S1 (Sec. 4.2 ), the streaming solver for S3 (Sec. 4.3 ), provisional-structure handling for S2 (Sec. 4.4 ), and the verdict engine for S4 (Sec. 4.5 ).

paragraphs.en: OnTrack separates signals by their prerequisites into three decoupled layers: L1 vital signs (reference-free intrinsic diagnostics: loop detection, information gain, stall) run always; L2 transport alignment (the streaming UFGW machinery, Secs. 4.1 – 4.5 ) requires references; L3 pre-execution policy gate (tool-contract prerequisite checks plus a one-row proposal alignment, Sec. 4.5 ) requires schemas and is the only synchronous component — it evaluates the proposed action before the tool executes, exclusively for irreversible calls, so worst-case added latency is confined to the rare actions that warrant it. L1 is not optimal transport and we do not present it as such; it is the honest degradation mode when no reference of any provenance exists.
paragraphs.zh: OnTrack 根据信号的前置条件，将其划分为三个解耦的层：L1 生命体征（无需参考的内在诊断：循环检测、信息增益、停滞）始终运行；L2 传输对齐（流式 UFGW 机制，第 4.1 – 4.5 节）需要参考；L3 预执行策略门控（工具合同的前置条件检查以及单行提案对齐，第 4.5 节）需要模式定义，也是唯一的同步组件——它在工具执行前评估所提议的动作，且仅针对不可逆调用，因此最坏情况下的额外延迟仅限于那些确实需要该机制的罕见动作。 L1 并非最优传输方式，我们也不将其视为如此；当不存在任何来源的参考时，它会进入一种诚实的降级模式。

paragraphs.en: Implementation notes: three distinct quantities. The paper handles three related but distinct objects, and we keep them separate throughout. (i) The exact objective , Eq. ( 2 ), defines the alignment problem and is what the theory refers to. (ii) The fast online optimizer deviates from it in two documented ways: the per-event linearization clips negative entries of the GW gradient to zero (keeping the Gibbs kernel bounded), and the diagnostic loss reported alongside verdicts approximates the two KL penalties by an L 1 L_{1} total-mass surrogate λ ⁡ ( | 𝟏 ⊤ ​ 𝐓𝟏 − 𝟏 ⊤ ​ 𝝁 | + | 𝟏 ⊤ ​ 𝐓 ⊤ ​ 𝟏 − 𝟏 ⊤ ​ 𝝂 ( t ) | ) \lambda\,(|\mathbf{1}^{\!\top}\mathbf{T}\mathbf{1}-\mathbf{1}^{\!\top}\bm{\mu}|+|\mathbf{1}^{\!\top}\mathbf{T}^{\!\top}\mathbf{1}-\mathbf{1}^{\!\top}\bm{\nu}^{(t)}|) and clips the quadratic form at zero. (iii) The finalization path runs the same implemented solver (clipped gradient, surrogate diagnostic) with the mask removed and a converged schedule — it is not an exact minimization of Eq. ( 2 ), and Prop. 1 is stated accordingly, as equality with a batch evaluator running the same implementation. All verdict thresholds are calibrated directly on the implemented quantities, so the deviations affect interpretation of the loss scale, not the calibrated behavior.

The gate runs on the proposed action q t = ( a t , τ t , c t ) q_{t}=(a_{t},\tau_{t},c_{t}) — available before the tool executes, before any post-state artifact exists, and before row t t enters the coupling. (Recomputing rather than reading the cached frontier matters: the cache is one event stale for a pre-execution check, and an earlier implementation that used it blocked valid calls — see the gate tests in Sec. 6.1 .) paragraphs.en: Independent coupling states are maintained per reference and aggregated by temperature-controlled soft-min [ 4 ] ; K K is small (3–10) and cost is linear in K K . The running arg ⁡ min \arg\min doubles as a live “which strategy is the agent following” diagnostic. Reference provenance scales verdict authority: gold and mined references (clustered successful production traces) enable interventions; axiomatic references built at runtime from tool produces/consumes contracts enable L3 and downgraded warnings; planner-generated skeletons — which re-import the LLM-as-a-judge circularity — may inform but never trigger an automatic halt. With no reference at all, L2 is off and OnTrack degrades, explicitly, to L1 + L3.
paragraphs.zh: 每个参考都保持独立的耦合状态，并通过温度控制的软最小化 [ 4 ] 进行聚合；K K 很小（3–10），且成本与 K K 呈线性关系。 运行中的 arg ⁡ min \arg\min 同时充当一个实时的“智能体正在遵循哪种策略”的诊断指标。 参考的来源决定了裁决的权威性：黄金参考和挖掘出的参考（成功生成轨迹的聚类）支持干预；在运行时基于工具产生/消耗的合同构建的公理参考支持 L3 和降级警告；规划器生成的骨架——这会重新引入“LLM 作为裁判”的循环性——可能提供信息，但绝不会触发自动停止。 如果完全没有参考，L2 将关闭，而 OnTrack 会明确降级为 L1 + L3。

paragraphs.en: Three qualifications are inherent. The reduction is to the implemented procedure, not to an exact minimization of Eq. ( 2 ): the finalization path uses the same clipped gradient and surrogate diagnostic as the fast path, so equality with an exact-UFGW batch score would additionally require an unclipped, exact-KL final solve, which we do not currently perform. The UFGW objective is nonconvex, so even then the guarantee would concern the solver’s output, not a global optimum. And the reduction is conditional on online dependency extraction agreeing with the batch-extracted graph, which retroactive repair targets but cannot guarantee (Sec. 4.4 ). Finally, a definition: the empirical ≤ 0.013 \leq 0.013 figure (Sec. 6.1 ) is the end-of-stream discrepancy — the running fast-path diagnostic over the stream against the eventual finalization output. It is a consistency check across the whole run, not a per-prefix tracking gap; the proper tracking experiment (fast-path versus converged solve on the same prefix, mask, marginals, and references) is well-defined and left to the released artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 三项资格是固有的。 这种简化针对的是已实施的过程，而非对公式的精确最小化。 (2)：最终确定路径使用与快速路径相同的截断梯度和代理诊断指标，因此要与精确的 UFGW 批量分数相等，还需要进行未经截断且精确的 KL 最终求解，而目前我们并未执行该步骤。 UFGW 目标函数是非凸的，因此即便如此，该保证也只涉及求解器的输出，而非全局最优解。 此外，这种简化还依赖于在线依赖提取与批量提取的图结构一致，而回溯性修复只能针对此问题，却无法提供保证（第 4.4 节）。 最后，给出一个定义：经验值 ≤0.013（第 6.1 节）代表的是流结束时的差异——即在整个数据流中，快速路径的诊断指标与最终确定输出之间的差异。 这是一项贯穿整个运行过程的连贯性检查，而非针对每个前缀的跟踪差距；正确的跟踪实验（在相同的前缀、掩码、边缘概率和参考数据上比较快速路径与收敛求解器）定义明确，并留待已发布的成果中实现。

paragraphs.en: Full online serialization invariance is deliberately not claimed as a theorem: even under exact per-event optimization, two serializations that expose the same covered sub-DAG can assign different ages to its nodes (different age-weighted structural costs) and arrive with different warm-start couplings, both path-dependent. What holds by construction is the proposition above; what holds at termination is exact, because the finalization path disables age weights (batch convention, Sec. 4.4 ) and runs the cold-started procedure of Prop. 1 , removing both sources of path dependence. Mid-stream serialization invariance is therefore an empirical property: Scenario B of Table 2 , where a reordered run tracks and finalizes to the identical score, is its validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并未刻意将完整的在线序列化不变性作为定理来提出：即使在每次事件都进行精确优化的情况下，两种暴露了相同覆盖子DAG的序列化方式也可能为其节点分配不同的年龄（即不同的年龄加权结构成本），并以不同的热启动耦合方式达成结果，而这两种方式都是路径依赖的。 根据构造成立的是上述命题；在终止时成立的是精确性，因为最终化过程会禁用年龄权重（批次约定，第4.4节），并运行命题1中的冷启动程序，从而消除两种路径依赖的来源。 因此，中间流序列化不变性是一种经验性质：表2中的场景B即为此种性质的验证，在该场景中，一次重排序后的运行能够追踪并最终化到完全相同的得分。

paragraphs.en: Let a redundant leaf step (no downstream dependencies, arbitrary attributes) be inserted at any position in the stream, and suppose the masked reference marginal 𝛎 ( t ) \bm{\nu}^{(t)} and the existing prefix structure are unchanged by the insertion (the leaf neither satisfies a reference node nor adds edges among existing nodes). Under the constant per-node mass of Eq. ( 3 ), the increase in the optimal objective is at most λ / m ¯ \lambda/\bar{m} — the generalized-KL cost of annihilating the node’s mass μ = 1 / m ¯ \mu=1/\bar{m} — so the aggregate perturbation decays as O ⁡ ( 1 / t ) O(1/t) relative to total transported mass; its node leakage ℓ \ell lies in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by definition (Eq. 4 ) and attains 1 1 exactly when the node’s mass is fully destroyed.
paragraphs.zh: 假设在流中的任意位置插入一个冗余叶节点（无下游依赖，属性任意），并假设掩码参考边际 𝛎 ( t ) \bm{\nu}^{(t)} 和现有的前缀结构因该插入而保持不变（该叶节点既不满足任何参考节点，也不在现有节点之间添加边）。根据公式 (3) 中每个节点的恒定质量，最优目标函数的增量最多为 λ / m ¯ \lambda/\bar{m}——即消除该节点质量 μ = 1 / m ¯ \mu=1/\bar{m} 时的广义 KL 成本——因此，相对于总传输质量，整体扰动以 O ⁡ ( 1 / t ) O(1/t) 的速度衰减；根据定义（公式 4），其节点泄漏 ℓ \ell 位于 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 之间，且当且仅当该节点的质量被完全摧毁时达到 1 1。

paragraphs.en: Extending the previous optimal coupling by an all-zero row for the inserted leaf is feasible: the linear and quadratic terms gain nothing from a zero row, the entropy contribution of zero entries vanishes, and the row-marginal penalty gains λ KL ( 0 ∥ 1 / m ¯ ) = λ / m ¯ \lambda\,\mathrm{KL}(0\,\|\,1/\bar{m})=\lambda/\bar{m} under the generalized KL of Eq. ( 2 ). The new optimum is bounded above by this feasible point. Note this is an upper bound, not an identity: the optimizer may rearrange mass on existing rows, and the leaf may couple partially rather than be destroyed. The bound concerns the exact objective Eq. ( 2 ); for the implemented L 1 L_{1} mass surrogate the same feasible-extension argument yields the same constant λ / m ¯ \lambda/\bar{m} (a zero row shifts the total-mass gap by exactly 1 / m ¯ 1/\bar{m} ). This is the streaming counterpart of the redundant-leaf bound of [ 4 ] with r = 1 r=1 and constant node mass. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 通过为插入的叶节点添加一个全零行来扩展先前的最优耦合是可行的：线性项和二次项在零行上无法获得任何收益，零元素的熵贡献为零，而在方程（2）的广义KL散度下，行边际惩罚项则为 λ KL ( 0 ∥ 1 / m ¯ ) = λ / m ¯ \lambda\,\mathrm{KL}(0\,\|\,1/\bar{m})=\lambda/\bar{m}。新的最优解以该可行点为上限。请注意，这是一个上界，而非恒等式：优化器可能会重新分配现有行上的质量，并且该叶节点可能仅部分耦合，而非被完全消除。此界与精确目标函数方程（2）相关；对于实际实现的 L 1 L_{1} 质量替代函数，相同的可行扩展论证也会得出相同的常数 λ / m ¯ \lambda/\bar{m}（一个零行会使总质量差距恰好偏移 1 / m ¯ 1/\bar{m}）。这是 [4] 中冗余叶节点界在 r = 1 r=1 且节点质量恒定时对应的流式处理版本。∎

paragraphs.en: Under age weights ( 10 ), the direct structural cost of row i i in the linearized objective is zero at its emission event, and at most the fraction ( t − t i ) / h age < 1 (t-t_{i})/h_{\mathrm{age}}<1 of its full magnitude for the following h age h_{\mathrm{age}} events — unless one of its artifacts is consumed earlier, in which case its structural row is exact along the evidenced edges and the discount is lifted. paragraphs.en: Three readings are honest here, and we distinguish them. First, attribution: loops and stalls are carried entirely by the reference-free L1 heuristics — every variant, including the rule baseline, matches on them. Second, at the shipped threshold the quadratic structure term selects a lower-FPR operating point : removing the mask changes almost nothing (13/40 → \to 14/40 false-positive traces at essentially identical recall), while removing the GW term more than doubles the benign false-alarm count (29/40), to nearly the level of running no transport at all (L1-only 31/40, rule baseline 32/40). Third, the recall side remains an operating-point contrast, not a dominance result: at the shipped thresholds the full system sits at a conservative point (12/30 recall on hallucinations and inversions) while the no-GW and rule variants sit at high-recall, high-FPR points (21–26/30 recall at 29–32/40 FPR). Threshold sweeps with per-point counts and Wilson intervals (released with the code; n = 120 n{=}120 benign, 100 100 per fault) quantify this: loop and stall AUPRC is 0.70 0.70 – 0.74 0.74 for every variant (base rate 0.45 0.45 ), while hallucination and inversion AUPRC sits at 0.44 0.44 – 0.47 0.47 — essentially the base rate — for all variants, i.e., the precision–recall curves are indistinguishable and only the shipped operating point differs. We therefore claim the FPR contrast at deployed thresholds, not curve-level dominance.
paragraphs.zh: 此处有三项读数是诚实的，并且我们对其进行了区分。 首先，归因问题：循环和停滞完全由无参考的 L1 启发式方法承担——所有变体（包括规则基线）都与之匹配。 其次，在已发布的阈值下，二次结构项会选择 FPR 较低的运行点：移除掩码几乎不会改变任何结果（假阳性轨迹从 13/40 → \to 14/40，召回率基本相同），而移除 GW 项则会使良性误报数量增加一倍以上（达到 29/40），几乎与完全不运行传输（L1-only 为 31/40，规则基线为 32/40）的水平相当。 第三，召回率方面仍然是一个运行点的对比，而非主导性结果：在已发布的阈值下，完整系统处于保守点（对幻觉和倒置的召回率为 12/30），而无 GW 和规则变体则处于高召回率、高 FPR 的点（召回率为 21–26/30，FPR 为 29–32/40）。 带有每点计数和威尔逊区间的阈值扫描（随代码一同发布；n = 120 n{=}120 个良性样本，每个故障 100 个样本）对此进行了量化：所有变体的循环和停滞 AUPRC 均为 0.70 0.70 – 0.74 0.74（基线为 0.45 0.45），而幻觉和倒置的 AUPRC 在所有变体中均处于 0.44 0.44 – 0.47 0.47——基本与基线相同——也就是说，精确率-召回率曲线无法区分，只有已发布的运行点存在差异。 因此，我们主张在部署阈值下存在 FPR 对比，而非曲线层面的主导性。

sents.en: Second, at the shipped threshold the quadratic structure term selects a lower-FPR operating point : removing the mask changes almost nothing (13/40 → \to 14/40 false-positive traces at essentially identical recall), while removing the GW term more than doubles the benign false-alarm count (29/40), to nearly the level of running no transport at all (L1-only 31/40, rule baseline 32/40).
sents.zh: 其次，在已发布的阈值下，二次结构项会选择 FPR 较低的运行点：移除掩码几乎不会改变任何结果（假阳性轨迹从 13/40 → \to 14/40，召回率基本相同），而移除 GW 项则会使良性误报数量增加一倍以上（达到 29/40），几乎与完全不运行传输（L1-only 为 31/40，规则基线为 32/40）的水平相当。

sents.en: Third, the recall side remains an operating-point contrast, not a dominance result: at the shipped thresholds the full system sits at a conservative point (12/30 recall on hallucinations and inversions) while the no-GW and rule variants sit at high-recall, high-FPR points (21–26/30 recall at 29–32/40 FPR).
sents.zh: 第三，召回率方面仍然是一个运行点的对比，而非主导性结果：在已发布的阈值下，完整系统处于保守点（对幻觉和倒置的召回率为 12/30），而无 GW 和规则变体则处于高召回率、高 FPR 的点（召回率为 21–26/30，FPR 为 29–32/40）。

sents.en: Threshold sweeps with per-point counts and Wilson intervals (released with the code; n = 120 n{=}120 benign, 100 100 per fault) quantify this: loop and stall AUPRC is 0.70 0.70 – 0.74 0.74 for every variant (base rate 0.45 0.45 ), while hallucination and inversion AUPRC sits at 0.44 0.44 – 0.47 0.47 — essentially the base rate — for all variants, i.e., the precision–recall curves are indistinguishable and only the shipped operating point differs.
sents.zh: 带有每点计数和威尔逊区间的阈值扫描（随代码一同发布；n = 120 n{=}120 个良性样本，每个故障 100 个样本）对此进行了量化：所有变体的循环和停滞 AUPRC 均为 0.70 0.70 – 0.74 0.74（基线为 0.45 0.45），而幻觉和倒置的 AUPRC 在所有变体中均处于 0.44 0.44 – 0.47 0.47——基本与基线相同——也就是说，精确率-召回率曲线无法区分，只有已发布的运行点存在差异。

sents.en: We therefore claim the FPR contrast at deployed thresholds, not curve-level dominance.
sents.zh: 因此，我们主张在部署阈值下存在 FPR 对比，而非曲线层面的主导性。

The end-of-stream discrepancy — the running fast-path diagnostic against the eventual finalization output, as defined in the remark after Prop. 1 — never exceeds 0.013 across the campaign (and is 0 after finalization); per-event runtime spans 0.2–1.6 ms.

paragraphs.en: The primary protocol, used for every headline number, is a single fixed held-out evaluation: all evaluation-partition traces with at least k k steps, every method scored on exactly the same traces, and bootstrap 95% CIs ( n = 1,000 n{=}1{,}000 ) on AUROC and on the difference vs. cosine. Since this corpus has exactly one trace per instance (2,288 unique instances, 2,288 traces), instance-clustered and trace-level bootstrap coincide. AUROC orientation: the resolved class is positive; the OnTrack score s s (higher = better aligned) is used directly, and each baseline is oriented so that higher predicts resolution (length- and flag-count-type signals negated). A secondary protocol — five seeds redrawing balanced ≈ \approx 200-trace samples, with the partition, references, and λ \lambda fixed — is reported in Appendix A for robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 用于每个标题编号的主要协议是单次固定的预留评估：所有包含至少 k 个步骤的评估分区轨迹，所有方法均基于完全相同的轨迹进行评分，并对 AUROC 以及与余弦的差异进行 95% 的自助置信区间（n = 1,000）计算。 由于该语料库中每个实例仅有一条轨迹（共 2,288 个唯一实例，2,288 条轨迹），因此基于实例聚类和基于轨迹层面的自助法结果一致。 AUROC 方向性：被识别出的类别为正向；OnTrack 得分 s（数值越高表示对齐度越好）直接用于评估，且每个基线模型的方向均被调整，使得更高的分数能够预测识别结果（长度和标志计数类型的信号已被反转）。 一项次要协议——通过五个种子重新抽取平衡的约 200 条轨迹样本，同时保持分区、参考数据和 λ 固定不变——作为稳健性分析在附录 A 中报告。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 is the primary evaluation. Baselines beyond those of Sec. 6.2 : LinUOT is linear unbalanced OT ( θ = 0 \theta{=}0 , no structure term); GED is a graph-edit-distance proxy (label-multiset distance plus edge overlap on the tool-labeled dependency graph); a Laplace-smoothed trigram model and the prerequisite-rule detector from the component study are evaluated but weaker throughout (trigram declining from .596 .596 to .538 .538 ; rule at or below chance) and omitted from the table for space. Four observations. First, the Δ \Delta CI excludes zero at k ≤ 10 k\leq 10 , and the advantage is gone by k = 15 k{=}15 , where cosine catches up ( .633 .633 vs. .635 .635 ): the claim is an early-trajectory advantage, precisely the regime an in-flight monitor operates in. Second, at the earliest checkpoint trace length alone is the single best signal ( n_steps .622 .622 at k = 5 k{=}5 ); OnTrack leads every content- and structure-aware method there but not the length prior — its clearest regime is k = 8 k{=}8 – 10 10 , after the length prior fades and before content accumulates. Third, LinUOT tracks OnTrack within 0.003 0.003 – 0.010 0.010 AUROC everywhere: the quadratic term contributes essentially nothing to ranking on this corpus, consistent with its role as a false-alarm suppressor rather than a ranker (Table 4 ); the mask-free variant is AUROC-identical to the full system, confirming the mask’s null ranking effect here as well. Fourth, the balanced multi-seed protocol (Appendix A ) agrees in direction with somewhat larger deltas; we cite the primary protocol’s numbers everywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 表5是主要评估结果。 除第6.2节中提到的基线方法外，还评估了其他基线：LinUOT是线性不平衡最优传输（θ = 0，无结构项）；GED是图编辑距离的代理指标（标签多重集距离加上工具标注依赖图中的边重叠）；此外还评估了拉普拉斯平滑三语法模型和组件研究中的前提规则检测器，但它们在各方面表现均较弱（三语法得分从0.596降至0.538；规则检测准确率处于偶然水平或更低），因此出于空间限制未列入表格。以下有四点观察结果。 首先，当k ≤ 10时，Δ CI不包含零值，而当k = 15时优势消失，此时余弦相似度追上了差距（0.633 vs. 0.635）：这一结论表明优势仅出现在早期阶段，而这正是飞行监控器所运行的区间。 其次，在最早期的检查点中，仅依赖步长数（n_steps）就是单一的最佳信号（k = 5时得分为0.622）；此时OnTrack优于所有考虑内容和结构的方法，但不及仅基于步长数的模型——其表现最清晰的区间是k = 8–10，即步长数信号减弱而内容尚未积累的阶段。 第三，LinUOT在所有情况下的AUROC值与OnTrack的差距均未超过0.003–0.010：二次项在此语料库的排序中几乎没有任何贡献，这与它作为误报抑制器而非排序器的作用一致（表4）；无掩码版本与完整系统的AUROC完全相同，进一步证实了掩码在此处的排序效应为零。 第四，平衡多种子协议（附录A）的方向性与稍大的差异值一致；我们在各处均引用了主要协议的数据。

paragraphs.en: We compare against four baselines on the same 150+150 profiles: step-cutoff (abort when step count exceeds N N ), budget-cutoff (abort when cumulative cost exceeds a fraction of the median resolved-trace cost), cosine-cutoff (abort when running cosine-to-reference drops below a threshold), and a hybrid (flag-density OR step-cutoff). The honest finding is that the savings-vs-false-stop frontier alone does not select a winner . At a matched ≈ \approx 20% false-stop rate, flag-density (17.9%) and an interpolated step-cutoff ( ≈ \approx 16.5%) save comparable cost; at ≈ \approx 29% false stops, blunt early policies save more (cosine-cutoff 37.9%, budget-cutoff 31.9%, vs. flag-density 28.0%), because savings track how early a policy fires and nothing fires earlier than a cutoff that barely looks at the trace (cosine-cutoff’s median abort is step 6, vs. 33–44 for flag density). The hybrid tracks the step-cutoff frontier and adds nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同的 150+150 个配置文件上，将我们的方法与四种基线方法进行了比较：步数截断（当步数超过 N 时中止）、预算截断（当累计成本超过已解决轨迹成本中位数的一定比例时中止）、余弦截断（当运行中的余弦值与参考值的比率低于某一阈值时中止），以及一种混合方法（标志密度 OR 步数截断）。 诚实的结论是，仅凭“节省成本 vs 误停”的边界曲线本身无法选出一个获胜者。 在匹配的大约 \approx 20% 的误停率下，标志密度（17.9%）和插值步数截断（\approx 16.5%）节省的成本相当；而在大约 \approx 29% 的误停率下，直接的早期中止策略能节省更多成本（余弦截断为 37.9%，预算截断为 31.9%，而标志密度为 28.0%），因为成本节省反映了策略中止的早迟程度，而几乎没有查看轨迹的截断策略会比任何策略都更早中止（余弦截断的中止步数为第 6 步，而标志密度的中止步数在 33–44 之间）。 混合方法追踪了步数截断的边界曲线，但并未带来任何额外效果。

paragraphs.en: What separates the policies is operability , on two axes. First, threshold stability: cosine-cutoff’s frontier is pathologically sensitive — moving its threshold from 0.40 to 0.55 swings the false-stop rate from 3.3% to 28% to 73% to 95%, so a miscalibration of 0.05 turns it from inert into a kill-everything switch — whereas flag density degrades gracefully across its entire range (29% to 19% false stops over thresholds 0.2–0.7). Second, actionability: a cutoff emits a bare kill signal, while a severe-flag trigger fires with a verdict ( LOOP at step t t , STALLED since step t − w t{-}w ) that supports graduated responses — replan, inject guidance, escalate to a human — of which aborting is only the bluntest. We therefore present the abort experiment as evidence that the verdict stream supports a candidate operating policy that is reasonably stable on this corpus, not that it dominates the savings frontier. A full expected-utility analysis — pricing an aborted success at its completion cost plus lost outcome value rather than by its compute alone — is needed before any of these policies is production-ready, and is future work.
paragraphs.zh: 区分这些策略的关键在于其可操作性，这体现在两个维度上。 首先，阈值稳定性：余弦截断法的边界具有病态敏感性——将其阈值从 0.40 调整到 0.55，会使误停率从 3.3% 波动至 28%、73% 乃至 95%；因此，仅 0.05 的轻微误校准就会使其从无效状态转变为“全部终止”开关——而标志密度则在整个范围内呈现平滑下降（在 0.2–0.7 的阈值区间内，误停率从 29% 降至 19%）。 其次，可操作性：截断法仅发出一个简单的终止信号，而严重标志触发器则会附带一个裁决（例如，“在第 t 步进入循环”，“自第 t − w 步起停滞”），从而支持分阶段响应——如重新规划、注入指导或升级至人工干预——其中中止只是最粗暴的一种手段。 因此，我们提出中止实验作为证据，表明该裁决流支持一种在此语料库上具有合理稳定性的候选操作策略，而非证明其优于其他策略的节省边界。 在将这些策略投入实际使用之前，需要进行完整的预期效用分析——即将中止的成功案例按其完成成本加上损失的结果价值进行定价，而不仅仅是依据计算资源消耗——这属于未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: SWE-agent traces exit with cost_limit_exceeded (401 traces, combining exit_cost and submitted (exit_cost) ) or clean submission (1,868); the remaining 19 traces carry other exit statuses ( None or early_exit ) and are excluded from this binary comparison. We evaluate on a balanced 50+50 sample. This is a pure process anomaly: cost-limit traces are agents that ran out of budget, not agents that chose wrong actions. Table 7 shows that OnTrack score (0.979) and flags (0.977) dominate cosine (0.557) and statistically match n_steps (0.978). paragraphs.en: To test structural sensitivity beyond outcome labels, we inject 3-step segments from real unresolved traces into resolved traces at random positions (60 pairs). Unlike out-of-distribution hallucinations (weather-API or infrastructure calls, which any embedding-distance method detects trivially), these donor steps use the same tool vocabulary as the host trace. The honest result is that such splices sit near the detection floor on this corpus: AUC(score) = 0.546, AUC(flags) = 0.540, cosine 0.516, and the per-trace leakage delta between spliced and clean versions is not significant ( p = 0.93 p=0.93 ). Every spliced trace raises at least one flag, but unspliced host traces of comparable length flag at nearly the same rate, so trace-level “detection rate” is not a meaningful metric here and we do not report it as one. Three real SWE-agent steps borrowed from another debugging session are, locally, a plausible continuation — separating them requires task-level semantics that a process monitor with task-generic references does not have. We report this as a characterization of the method’s floor on homogeneous real traces, in deliberate contrast to the controlled setting of Sec. 6.1 where injected anomalies violate the reference structure and are caught exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试超出结果标签的结构敏感性，我们将来自真实未解决轨迹的 3 步片段随机注入到已解决轨迹中的随机位置（共 60 对）。 与分布外幻觉（如天气 API 或基础设施调用，这些都能被任何嵌入距离方法轻易检测出来）不同，这些捐赠步骤使用的工具词汇表与宿主轨迹完全相同。 诚实的结果是，在此语料库中，这类拼接片段几乎处于检测阈值附近：AUC(score) = 0.546，AUC(flags) = 0.540，余弦相似度为 0.516，且拼接版本与干净版本之间的每轨迹泄露差异并不显著（p = 0.93）。 每个拼接后的轨迹都会触发至少一个标志，但长度相当的未拼接宿主轨迹触发标志的比例几乎相同，因此轨迹级别的“检测率”在此并非有意义的指标，我们也不会将其作为指标报告。 从另一个调试会话中借用的三个真实 SWE 智能体步骤，在局部来看是合理的延续——要区分它们需要任务层面的语义，而一个具有通用任务引用的进程监控器并不具备这种能力。 我们将此结果视为该方法在同质真实轨迹上的性能下限的表征，这与第 6.1 节中受控设置形成有意对比：在该设置中，注入的异常违反了参考结构，因而被精准捕捉。

paragraphs.en: On a balanced sample (50 resolved, 50 unresolved), no method reliably separates outcomes (Table 8 ): OnTrack reaches 0.581, cosine 0.643, with widely overlapping bootstrap CIs. Point estimates are unstable at this sample size — an independent draw of the evaluation sample yields OnTrack 0.666 vs. cosine 0.657, reversing the ordering — so the only conclusion the data support is that neither process alignment nor content similarity predicts patch correctness from the trajectory alone. This is the expected boundary: both resolved and unresolved SWE-agent traces follow the same search → \to read → \to edit → \to test template, and the difference between success and failure lies in which line was edited , which no task-generic trajectory signal observes.

paragraphs.en: OnTrack shows that structure-aware optimal transport — until now a post-hoc instrument — can run inside the agent loop and act in real time, without surrendering the properties that made it worth having. The quadratic structure term survives through amortized conditional gradient; the prefix problem is solved by frontier-masked marginals that keep order-freedom where the DAG permits it and convert agent-side mass leakage into a real-time signal; and every intervention rests on per-node transport marginals, escalated to a converged solve before action.

paragraphs.en: On 2,294 SWE-agent trajectories, OnTrack provides early-trajectory discrimination that outperforms cosine similarity where it matters most — the first ten steps ( + 0.057 +0.057 AUROC at k = 8 k{=}8 under the primary held-out protocol, instance-level bootstrap 95% CI [ + 0.033 , + 0.080 ] [+0.033,+0.080] , excluding zero through k = 10 k{=}10 ) — and a candidate flag-density abort policy stops roughly one in four failing runs, saving 17–18% of compute on the failed population at ≈ \approx 83% deployment-adjusted precision. Rival stopping policies can match or exceed those savings at matched false-stop rates; what the verdict stream adds to the stopping frontier is graceful degradation under threshold miscalibration, an interpretable reason, and a graduated response rather than a bare kill signal. The component study clarifies what the transport machinery changes on real traces: not recall — L1 heuristics and even a prerequisite-rule baseline match or exceed it there — but the operating point : at shipped thresholds the quadratic structure term selects a point with less than half the benign false-alarm rate of every reference-free variant (13/40 vs. 29–32/40 benign traces flagged; removing the frontier mask instead shifts the count by one trace); establishing curve-level dominance remains open, and we do not claim generally superior detection precision. The precise summary of the real-trace evidence is this: on homogeneous SWE-agent traces, OnTrack provides a modest early advantage over content similarity, and its main structural contribution is selecting a lower-false-alarm operating point rather than improving ranking. On real traces, the demonstrated strengths are loops, stalls, deviation from a known reference structure, and schema-checkable prerequisite violations; we do not claim general in-the-wild detection of hallucinations or causal inversions, whose real-trace signal sits near the floor on homogeneous corpora. Cost-limit failures are detected at 0.979 AUROC, on par with trace length post hoc but available as a calibrated trigger mid-trace. We are equally transparent about the boundaries: on real, homogeneous traces, in-distribution splices sit near the detection floor, and no task-generic trajectory signal — ours or any baseline — predicts patch correctness once length is controlled. OnTrack is a process monitor, not an oracle, and we believe the distinction is worth drawing clearly.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2,294 条 SWE-agent 轨迹上，OnTrack 提供了早期轨迹的判别能力，在最重要的阶段——前十个步骤——其表现优于余弦相似度（在主要保留协议下，k = 8 时 AUROC 提升 +0.057，实例级自助法 95% CI 为 [+0.033, +0.080]，排除 k = 10 之前的零值）；同时，一种候选标志密度中止策略可终止约四分之一的失败运行，在失败群体中节省 17–18% 的计算资源，且部署调整后的精确度约为 83%。 其他中止策略在相同误停率下也能达到或超越这些节省效果；而裁决流为中止边界带来的额外价值，是在阈值误校准情况下仍能实现优雅降级、提供可解释的原因，以及采用渐进式响应而非简单的终止信号。 该组件研究阐明了传输机制在真实轨迹上的变化：并非召回率——L1 启发式方法甚至基于前提规则的基线模型在此方面都能匹配或超越它——而是工作点：在已部署的阈值下，二次结构项会选择比所有无参考变体低一半以上的良性误报率的点（40 条良性轨迹中分别有 13/40 和 29–32/40 被标记；移除边界掩码后，该计数仅变化一条轨迹）；在曲线层面确立主导地位仍是开放问题，且我们并未声称其检测精确度普遍更优。 真实轨迹证据的精确总结如下：在同质 SWE-agent 轨迹上，OnTrack 相比内容相似度具有轻微的早期优势，其主要结构贡献是选择误报率更低的工作点，而非提升排序能力。 在真实轨迹中，已验证的优势包括循环、停滞、偏离已知参考结构以及可模式检查的前提规则违反；我们并未声称能普遍检测出真实场景中的幻觉或因果倒置，因为这些现象在同质语料库中的信号接近检测下限。 成本限制导致的失败可在 0.979 AUROC 下被检测到，这与事后分析中的轨迹长度相当，但也可作为校准后的触发机制在轨迹中途使用。 我们对边界同样透明：在真实、同质的轨迹中，分布内拼接部分接近检测下限，且没有任何通用任务轨迹信号——无论是我们的还是任何基线模型——能在控制轨迹长度后预测补丁的正确性。 OnTrack 是一个进程监控器，而非全知预言者，我们认为明确区分这一点至关重要。

sents.en: On 2,294 SWE-agent trajectories, OnTrack provides early-trajectory discrimination that outperforms cosine similarity where it matters most — the first ten steps ( + 0.057 +0.057 AUROC at k = 8 k{=}8 under the primary held-out protocol, instance-level bootstrap 95% CI [ + 0.033 , + 0.080 ] [+0.033,+0.080] , excluding zero through k = 10 k{=}10 ) — and a candidate flag-density abort policy stops roughly one in four failing runs, saving 17–18% of compute on the failed population at ≈ \approx 83% deployment-adjusted precision.
sents.zh: 在 2,294 条 SWE-agent 轨迹上，OnTrack 提供了早期轨迹的判别能力，在最重要的阶段——前十个步骤——其表现优于余弦相似度（在主要保留协议下，k = 8 时 AUROC 提升 +0.057，实例级自助法 95% CI 为 [+0.033, +0.080]，排除 k = 10 之前的零值）；同时，一种候选标志密度中止策略可终止约四分之一的失败运行，在失败群体中节省 17–18% 的计算资源，且部署调整后的精确度约为 83%。

sents.en: Rival stopping policies can match or exceed those savings at matched false-stop rates; what the verdict stream adds to the stopping frontier is graceful degradation under threshold miscalibration, an interpretable reason, and a graduated response rather than a bare kill signal.
sents.zh: 其他中止策略在相同误停率下也能达到或超越这些节省效果；而裁决流为中止边界带来的额外价值，是在阈值误校准情况下仍能实现优雅降级、提供可解释的原因，以及采用渐进式响应而非简单的终止信号。

sents.en: The component study clarifies what the transport machinery changes on real traces: not recall — L1 heuristics and even a prerequisite-rule baseline match or exceed it there — but the operating point : at shipped thresholds the quadratic structure term selects a point with less than half the benign false-alarm rate of every reference-free variant (13/40 vs. 29–32/40 benign traces flagged; removing the frontier mask instead shifts the count by one trace); establishing curve-level dominance remains open, and we do not claim generally superior detection precision.
sents.zh: 该组件研究阐明了传输机制在真实轨迹上的变化：并非召回率——L1 启发式方法甚至基于前提规则的基线模型在此方面都能匹配或超越它——而是工作点：在已部署的阈值下，二次结构项会选择比所有无参考变体低一半以上的良性误报率的点（40 条良性轨迹中分别有 13/40 和 29–32/40 被标记；移除边界掩码后，该计数仅变化一条轨迹）；在曲线层面确立主导地位仍是开放问题，且我们并未声称其检测精确度普遍更优。

sents.en: The precise summary of the real-trace evidence is this: on homogeneous SWE-agent traces, OnTrack provides a modest early advantage over content similarity, and its main structural contribution is selecting a lower-false-alarm operating point rather than improving ranking.
sents.zh: 真实轨迹证据的精确总结如下：在同质 SWE-agent 轨迹上，OnTrack 相比内容相似度具有轻微的早期优势，其主要结构贡献是选择误报率更低的工作点，而非提升排序能力。

sents.en: On real traces, the demonstrated strengths are loops, stalls, deviation from a known reference structure, and schema-checkable prerequisite violations; we do not claim general in-the-wild detection of hallucinations or causal inversions, whose real-trace signal sits near the floor on homogeneous corpora.
sents.zh: 在真实轨迹中，已验证的优势包括循环、停滞、偏离已知参考结构以及可模式检查的前提规则违反；我们并未声称能普遍检测出真实场景中的幻觉或因果倒置，因为这些现象在同质语料库中的信号接近检测下限。

sents.en: Cost-limit failures are detected at 0.979 AUROC, on par with trace length post hoc but available as a calibrated trigger mid-trace.
sents.zh: 成本限制导致的失败可在 0.979 AUROC 下被检测到，这与事后分析中的轨迹长度相当，但也可作为校准后的触发机制在轨迹中途使用。

sents.en: We are equally transparent about the boundaries: on real, homogeneous traces, in-distribution splices sit near the detection floor, and no task-generic trajectory signal — ours or any baseline — predicts patch correctness once length is controlled.
sents.zh: 我们对边界同样透明：在真实、同质的轨迹中，分布内拼接部分接近检测下限，且没有任何通用任务轨迹信号——无论是我们的还是任何基线模型——能在控制轨迹长度后预测补丁的正确性。

sents.en: OnTrack is a process monitor, not an oracle, and we believe the distinction is worth drawing clearly.
sents.zh: OnTrack 是一个进程监控器，而非全知预言者，我们认为明确区分这一点至关重要。

paragraphs.en: For robustness we repeat the partial-trajectory evaluation under a secondary protocol: five seeds, each redrawing a balanced ≈ \approx 200-trace evaluation sample (the instance partition, reference set, and calibrated λ \lambda are fixed across seeds).
paragraphs.zh: 为确保稳健性，我们在一个次要协议下重复了部分轨迹评估：使用五个种子，每个种子重新抽取一个平衡的约 ≈ 200 条轨迹的评估样本（实例划分、参考集和校准后的 λ \lambda 在所有种子中保持一致）。
